run_parallel_inference: run the script to launch depth filter and mask rcnn inference nodes in parallel
run_depth_filter_node: run the depth filter node script for body and head depth filtering in parallel
run_mask_rcnn_node: run the mask rcnn node script for object detection in parallel with depth filters
run_all_inference_nodes: run all three inference subprocesses simultaneously and wait for completion before killing
run_subprocess_parallel: run multiple python scripts as parallel subprocesses using subprocess.Popen and poll for completion
